title: Stability Watchdog: config-aware delta probes for embedding + reranker quality
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: We observe intermittent small regressions in embedding + reranker recall/precision after model binaries or scoring config changes. These regressions often escape basic shadow runs because they are config-dependent (batching, quantization, KV-cache behavior) or only surface on specific dataset slices. Goal: implement a lightweight, config-aware 'Stability Watchdog' that continuously computes delta metrics for offline evals tied to any config/model rollout and emits actionable alerts and triage metadata.

Scope: build probes that compute recall@k, precision@k, MRR and rank-similarity deltas across a set of canonical test slices (few-shot retrieval tasks, cold-start queries, long-context prompts). Probes must be tied to an explicit config fingerprint: model version + quantization profile + runtime flags (batch size, prefer_float16, cache_policy). When a config change is proposed (canary/cutover), the watchdog will run: 1) deterministic offline comparisons vs current baseline, 2) differential drift checks using distributional tests (ks-test on embedding norms, cosine similarity shifts), and 3) a lightweight synthetic adversarial probe suite to expose nonlinear rank flips. Results should surface per-slice metrics and per-request decomposition (e.g., by token-length, dataset, API path).

Deliverables: telemetry hooks (events + tags) so Console can show per-change deltas, an automated alert rule with severity levels, a triage playbook that attaches top-N failing queries and a plausible root cause (model vs config), and a small web UI in Console/QA dashboard that lists recent regressions with links to PRs and reproductions.
acceptance_criteria: Probe runs are triggered automatically on any model or scoring-config commit and store results in the eval datastore
Alerting fires for metric drops exceeding configurable thresholds and includes top-20 counterexamples and the config fingerprint
Console dashboard shows per-change delta snapshot (recall@5, precision@10, MRR) and a link to the triage artifact
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for fingerprint computation and deterministic eval runner. 2) End-to-end integration on staging: push synthetic config change; validate probes run and store metrics. 3) Fault injection: simulate embedding drift and verify alert severity escalates. 4) Load test: run probes for 10 concurrent rollouts without exceeding pipeline SLOs.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): hook probes to test model branches and kill-switch via feature-flag. Phase 2 (beta): enable for a subset of internal projects and expose dashboard. Phase 3 (GA): wire to canary gate so severe regressions block rollout. Provide docs and runbook for SRE/PM/ML reviewers.
risks: False positives due to noisy evaluation slices — mitigated by multi-slice consensus and rolling-window smoothing
Probe runtime cost if eval corpus is large — mitigate with sampling and incremental snapshots
Triage burden — include automatic root-cause heuristics and limit alert frequency
updates: 2026-02-11: Kickoff meeting — agreed on config fingerprint format and minimal metric set (recall@5, precision@10, MRR)
2026-02-24: Prototype of deterministic eval runner checked in (staging). Initial fingerprint includes model_hash, quant_profile, batch_policy
2026-03-03: Implemented distributional tests (cosine norm KS test) and basic alert rule generation. Observed small expected drift on long-context slice; added smoothing window
2026-03-12: Integrated produced probe events with Console telemetry schema. Dashboard scaffolded; requesting PM review for thresholds
